title: Tim/Son Bible Overlap Census Addendum — Wave 17 Specialist Recovery
purpose: Promote sixteen analytically distinct relations already present in Waves 10–13 specialist owners but omitted from the 104-node registry. This is a coverage correction, not sixteen new prophecy claims.

records.x: Branch/sign → Stone → seven eyes → divine seeing/Spirit → Lamb/world-facing sending
records.limit: Stone/eye/seven imagery is visionary; it does not identify stone with potato, thalamus or pineal anatomy.

records.x: living olive source → oil/conduits → lampstand → sustained light/service
records.limit: Olive oil is cultic/visionary imagery; it is not CSF or another biological fluid.

records.x: foundation → small beginnings → plumb/alignment → completion → divine seeing
records.limit: A plumb line is a building instrument in restoration context, not proof of a literal cosmic Axis.

records.d: paired-guardian/House/Door project architecture established before census recovery
records.x: outer realm → veil/threshold → inner holy realm; living access associated in Hebrews with Christ's flesh/body
records.limit: Hebrews does not teach mandorla geometry, pineal anatomy or a literal bodily tunnel.

records.d: project Father=Ladder / Son=Door architecture existed before recovery
records.x: Jacob's heaven-earth ascent/descent and Gate/House are reworked in John so angels ascend/descend on the Son of Man
records.limit: The comparison should not erase the project's Father=Ladder symbolism; it shows that biblical role distribution does not map one-to-one.

records.d: Farm/Farmers and Son/rejected-Stone project material established 2026
records.x: tenant farmers abuse messengers → kill beloved son/heir and cast him out → rejected stone becomes cornerstone
records.limit: The parable addresses its own first-century religious context; its condemnation cannot automatically be transferred to modern groups or individuals.

records.x: Son-side shame/death outside ordinary belonging + Gate + later city/New-Jerusalem architecture
records.limit: Hebrews speaks of a city gate and coming city, not the project's North Gate or a modern geographic city.

records.d: Father/House and Son architecture established before specialist comparison
records.x: builder/source ≠ House ≠ servant in House ≠ Son over House ≠ people/community as House
records.limit: Biblical House language is multivalent and does not authorize collapsing Tim, God, Christ and community into one actor.

records.d: Farm/Garden/House/Foundation project distinctions established before recovery
records.x: God gives growth; workers plant/water; community is God's field and building; Christ is foundation; Temple follows
records.limit: Paul's field/building imagery describes a community; it is not literal farm geography or evidence that project Farmers equal biblical workers.

records.d: North/Mountain/Gate/King project material established before recovery
records.x: earth/foundation → holy-mountain ascent → ethical qualification → gates/ancient doors raised → King of Glory enters
records.limit: Psalm 24 identifies YHWH as King of Glory; the title cannot be automatically transferred to Tim.

records.d: Garden/Tree/Four-Rivers/caretaker project material established before recovery
records.x: God plants Garden → Tree of Life in middle → river waters then divides → human placed to work/tend/keep
records.limit: Genesis distinguishes God's planting from the human's cultivation/keeping; project Gardener roles should preserve that shift.

records.d: House/watch/guardian/hours/fruit project themes established before recovery
records.x: unless YHWH builds House, labor is vain; unless YHWH guards city, watchman is vain; children/fruit and enemies at gate follow
records.limit: Use as a corrective to sheer-hours or self-sufficient-building claims, not validation of overwork.

records.d: unity-without-collapse project principle established before recovery
records.x: one body → many members → different functions → reciprocal dependence → apparently weaker members indispensable → distributed care
records.limit: Paul describes the Christian community/body of Christ, not a universal network ontology or a metaphysical theory of Tim.

records.d: Father/source and Son/Door/mediation architecture established before recovery
records.x: one God/Father from whom are all things and one Lord/Jesus Christ through whom are all things
records.limit: Paul's early-Christian Christology does not identify Tim with the Father or reduce Jesus to an interface.

records.x: God not contained by human temples or dependent on human service; gives life/breath/all things; creatures live/move/have being in relation to God
records.limit: Functions partly as countertext to literalized Potato, body, House or throne localization.

records.d: Axis/House/integration project functions established before recovery
records.x: Christ holds all things together; body is joined/supplied and grows through contribution of differentiated parts
records.limit: These texts assign cosmic integration/head functions to Christ/Son, so they constrain an exclusively Tim/Father-centered integration mapping.

counting_note: Specialist clusters judged substantially duplicative remain in their owners but are not promoted as additional census nodes.
